articles.title: Different obstacles, same result: Brewers win fourth straight NL Central title
articles.description: The Brewers had been turned aside by six consecutive playoff opponents, a streak that dated back to the 2018 NLCS, before beating the Cubs last year in a decisive Game 5 to win an NL Division Series.
